cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Investment in the Next Round
cards.instruction: Describe defeat, penalty, or a bad bargain as a deliberate investment in a larger future win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Losing the talent-show entry fee bought us a map of the competition.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We paid to learn what beats us. I'll turn the judges' comments into our next act.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll find a free contest. You pick which comments we use to win that one.
